relations.subject: Rubén L. F. Hábito
relations.evidence: There, he began practising under Yamada Kōun, a Zen rōshi who taught Christian students, which was unusual for the time. In 1988, Hábito received dharma transmission from Yamada.

relations.subject: Rubén L. F. Hábito
relations.evidence: in 1991 founded the Maria Kannon Zen Center, a lay organization in Dallas, Texas
